hero.tagline: You are not alone. Someone will pray for you.
hero.description: A prayer chain with no borders. It doesn't matter if you're far from a church or carrying something you've never told anyone. Here you can ask for prayer anonymously, and a real person commits to pray for you. No judgment. No exposure. Just prayer.
hero.verse: Bear one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
